name: nextloom-ai-skill
description: Agent Skills that teach AI agents to use the Nextloom AI CLI

scripts.sync:reference: curl -fsSL https://nextloom.ai/cli-reference.json -o cli-reference.json.tmp && node -e "const f=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync('cli-reference.json.tmp','utf8'));f.writeFileSync('cli-reference.json',JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n')" && rm cli-reference.json.tmp
